stories.title: Implement comparison normalization and ranking logic
stories.description: Build frontend logic to normalize provider scores, compute relative strengths/weaknesses, and highlight deltas between providers across measures.
stories.evidence: GAP: No comparison logic implemented; required to transform backend scores into user-understandable comparisons.
stories.acceptance_reason: Frontend normalization and relative-strength logic is a distinct, buildable unit with a clear dependency on S1's schema contract and a well-scoped responsibility.

requirements.requirement: The system must normalize all provider overall scores to a common 0–100 scale before comparison.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable, clear implementation path — normalize overall scores to 0–100, directly serves the normalization goal of the story.

requirements.requirement: The system must compute a rank ordering of providers based on normalized overall scores.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable, straightforward sort on normalized overall scores, directly serves the ranking goal of the story.

requirements.requirement: The system must compute per-measure rankings for each provider relative to others in the comparison set.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable, clear implementation as per-measure sort within the comparison set, serves the relative ranking goal.

requirements.requirement: The system must calculate score deltas between providers for each measure.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable, simple arithmetic between normalized measure scores per provider pair, directly serves the delta-highlighting goal.

requirements.requirement: The system must identify and label a provider's relative strengths where its score exceeds the comparison average for a measure.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable — score above comparison average gets a strength label; clear logic and directly serves the strengths/weaknesses goal.

requirements.requirement: The system must identify and label a provider's relative weaknesses where its score falls below the comparison average for a measure.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable — score below comparison average gets a weakness label; mirrors REQ-006 for the opposite case.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable boundary condition — comparison logic must accept 2+ providers without error, clear guard implementation.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable — missing values excluded from normalization without throwing errors; standard null-handling in frontend logic.

stories.title: Integrate comparison UI with API and state management
stories.description: Connect the comparison component to backend EVAL-COMPARE API, handle loading, error states, and dynamic provider selection.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/App.tsx (API integration patterns); GAP: No comparison API integration exists.
stories.acceptance_reason: API integration, loading/error states, and dynamic provider selection are clearly scoped, App.tsx integration patterns are correctly referenced, and the dependency on the backend EVAL-COMPARE API is explicitly declared.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (state updated and normalized data passed to UI component — yes/no), standard state management pattern with clear implementation path.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (loading indicator visible during pending request — yes/no), directly addresses the loading state requirement in the story description.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (comparison UI renders only after successful response — yes/no), prevents rendering stale or undefined data.

stories.title: Integrate comparison UI with API and state management
stories.description: Connect the comparison component to backend EVAL-COMPARE API, handle loading, error states, and dynamic provider selection.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/App.tsx (API integration patterns); GAP: No comparison API integration exists.
stories.acceptance_reason: API integration, loading/error states, and dynamic provider selection are clearly scoped, App.tsx integration patterns are correctly referenced, and the dependency on the backend EVAL-COMPARE API is explicitly declared.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (API called with provider IDs on init — yes/no), clear implementation path, directly serves the story's API integration goal.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (state updated and normalized data passed to UI component — yes/no), standard state management pattern with clear implementation path.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (loading indicator visible during pending request — yes/no), directly addresses the loading state requirement in the story description.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (comparison UI renders only after successful response — yes/no), prevents rendering stale or undefined data.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (error state with retry option displayed on API error — yes/no), directly serves the error states handling described in the story.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (UI rendering prevented and fallback shown on empty/malformed response — yes/no), defensive handling that is clearly implementable.

features.name: Clinical Trial Triage -- Is This Trial For You
features.description: Pre-qualification filter before quality scoring. Answers: is this trial relevant to you? Two checks: (1) Is the trial recruiting (enrollment status), (2) Does the trial condition match yours (condition relevance). If either fails, trial is excluded from quality scoring. These are not quality measures -- they are triage requirements.
features.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py (RECRUITING filter exists, condition field available).
features.accepted_by: Boss (rejected as measures, accepted as triage)

stories.title: Enrollment Status Triage
stories.description: Filter out trials that are not actively recruiting. Only trials with RECRUITING status pass triage.
stories.evidence: clinical_trials_service.py already has RECRUITING filter.

stories.title: Condition Relevance Triage
stories.description: Filter out trials whose conditions do not match the user query. Only trials with matching conditions pass triage.
stories.evidence: clinical_trials_models.py has structured condition field.

stories.title: Geographic Proximity Triage
stories.description: Filter out trials that are geographically infeasible. Uses travel calculation from clinical_trials_service.
stories.evidence: clinical_trials_service.py has _get_travel_info.

features.name: Trial Triage Display
features.description: Show the consumer why a trial passed or failed triage. Recruiting status and condition match displayed before quality scores.
features.evidence: GAP: No triage UI. MessageBubble.tsx rendering pipeline.

features.name: Principal Investigator Credibility Measure
features.description: Credibility of the trial lead investigator. Attributes: number of prior trials completed, publications, institutional affiliation, prior trial outcomes, and FDA approval track record (have this PIs prior trials resulted in FDA-approved treatments -- the ultimate credibility signal). A PI with completed trials that led to FDA approvals at a major research hospital is a stronger signal than a first-time PI at an unknown site.
features.evidence: ClinicalTrials.gov API returns investigator name and facility. ASSUMPTION: Can cross-reference investigator against PubMed for publications and against ClinicalTrials.gov history for prior trials. GAP: No PI credibility pipeline exists.

stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py orchestrates clinical trial responses; GAP: no PI-specific API contract currently exposed.
stories.acceptance_reason: API binding with error/null handling is a necessary and distinct concern from rendering logic; evaluate_care_facade.py exists as the backend orchestration layer, and the gap is honestly declared.

requirements.requirement: The system must retrieve PI credibility data from the backend response payload via evaluate_care_facade before rendering the trial scorecard.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Clear, boolean-testable requirement to retrieve PI data via evaluate_care_facade before rendering; implementation path through the facade is known.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Testable binding requirement referencing the schema defined in the accepted S1 story; I can validate field mapping against that schema.

stories.acceptance_reason: Defining the frontend data contract is the correct first step; MessageBubble.tsx exists as the rendering surface, the dependency on EVAL-CT-MEASURE-PI is legitimate, and the deliverable (a typed schema) is concrete and buildable.

features.name: Sponsoring Institution and Funding Credibility Measure
features.description: Credibility of the sponsoring institution and transparency of funding. Attributes: sponsor type (university, hospital, pharma, unknown), funding source (NIH/NCI = public, Industry, Other/undisclosed), institutional reputation, collaborating organizations. Public funding from a credible institution is a strong positive signal. Unknown sponsor with undisclosed funding is a negative signal.
features.evidence: ClinicalTrials.gov API returns lead_sponsor, collaborator, and funding_source fields. Data is public.

stories.title: Implement sponsor credibility scoring logic
stories.description: Build backend logic to classify sponsor type (university, hospital, pharma, unknown), normalize funding source (NIH/NCI/public vs industry vs undisclosed), and compute credibility score based on rules (public + reputable institution = positive, unknown + undisclosed = negative). Include collaborator influence and fallback handling for missing data.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py (existing ClinicalTrials.gov ingestion and transformation patterns).
stories.acceptance_reason: Scoring rules are well-defined by the feature attributes (sponsor type and funding source classification), the cited service file provides a proven transformation pattern, and the description is specific enough to code against.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable, clear implementation path using pattern matching and lookup table against lead_sponsor name from ClinicalTrials.gov data.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable and buildable; ClinicalTrials.gov provides agency_class/funding_source values (NIH, Industry, Other) that map cleanly to public/industry/undisclosed.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable rule that directly maps two classified inputs to a positive score output; straightforward to implement.

requirements.requirement: The system must assign a negative credibility score when sponsor_type is unknown AND funding_source is undisclosed.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable rule mapping the lowest-confidence inputs to a negative score; clear and buildable.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (score within 0–100 for every trial), establishes the bounded numeric contract needed by downstream consumers.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable and buildable; collaborators list is available from ClinicalTrials.gov and the same classification logic from REQ-001 applies.

requirements.requirement: The system must not increase credibility_score when collaborators are unknown or unclassified.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable negative-case guard that complements REQ-007; straightforward conditional check.

requirements.requirement: The system must set a transparency_flag to false when funding_source is undisclosed.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable single-condition flag assignment; trivially buildable.

requirements.requirement: The system must set a transparency_flag to true when funding_source is public or industry.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable complement to REQ-009 covering the disclosed funding cases.

requirements.requirement: The system must generate a deterministic credibility_score given identical input data.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable determinism constraint; essential for reproducibility and straightforward given rule-based (non-stochastic) scoring.

requirements.requirement: The system must default sponsor_type to unknown when lead_sponsor data is missing.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable default-handling rule for missing data; clear fallback behavior.

requirements.requirement: The system must default funding_source to undisclosed when funding data is missing.
requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable default-handling rule for missing funding data; mirrors REQ-012 pattern.

requirements.acceptance_reason: Boolean testable (aggregated collaborator influence must not exceed max bound from REQ-006); buildable with a clamping function on accumulation.

Include collaborator influence and fallback handling for missing data.

features.name: Mongo Lifecycle Management for Pipeline
features.description: Pipeline cluster is only running during jobs. Start cluster before job, pause/shutdown after completion. No idle clusters. No manual intervention by Boss.

epics.name: Pipeline Operations Manager
epics.goal: Build an infrastructure operations manager for the data pipelines that manages cluster lifecycle without knowledge of pipeline business logic.
epics.business_context: This is the operational manager of our data pipelines. Eventually this is the backend to an actual AI agent. When in real life the Ops Manager sees failure, they are not in the weeds understanding the data structures in the pipeline. They must understand how to read an error report from the failure. And ask the dev manager from the ETL job to do something if the fault is the pipeline code. But if the failure is in their management of the database they must understand how to fix it without bothering the dev manager for the actual content.

ops_manager.reads: Cluster health, reservation status, error codes
ops_manager.escalates_to: Dev Manager (Claude) if error is pipeline code, not infrastructure
ops_manager.never_touches: Pipeline data, task logic, collection schemas

dev_manager.owns: What the pipeline does -- load, enrich, embed, copy
dev_manager.acts: Run tasks, fix code, retry failed steps
dev_manager.never_touches: Cluster scaling, Atlas API, cost management

v01_api.ClusterStatus: GET -- returns cluster state + reservation list
v01_api.Release: POST -- release reservation, shut down if last one

epics.v01_timer: Every 5 minutes: check overdue reservations, shut down idle clusters, alert Boss. NO task execution.

features.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/cluster_lifecycle_manager.py (exists, needs refactor to remove pipeline knowledge).

features.name: ClusterStatus Endpoint
features.description: Returns current cluster state (IDLE/UPDATING/PAUSED), active reservations, overdue flags. Caller polls this after WakeCluster.
features.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/atlas_cluster_manager.py (get_cluster_state exists).

features.name: Error Classification — Rule-Based Precheck + LLM Triage
features.description: Two-tier error classification: deterministic rules first (connection errors → INFRA, schema errors → PIPELINE), then GPT-4.1-mini for ambiguous cases only. LLM selects repair actions from a config-driven allowlist only.
features.evidence: Website/ops-manager-design.html (Rule-Based Precheck table, LLM Triage section). Audit Finding F3.

stories.title: Implement rule-based precheck and LLM triage with allowlisted repair actions
stories.description: Apply deterministic rules for known error patterns before invoking GPT-4.1-mini. ConnectionFailure, ServerSelectionTimeoutError, AuthenticationFailed → INFRASTRUCTURE. KeyError, TypeError, ValidationError in pipeline code → PIPELINE. Ambiguous → LLM triage. Repair actions restricted to config-driven allowlist.
stories.evidence: Website/ops-manager-design.html

requirements.requirement: ConnectionFailure, ServerSelectionTimeoutError, AuthenticationFailed, TLS errors, and cluster state PAUSED/REPAIRING must be classified as INFRASTRUCTURE without invoking the LLM.
requirements.label: Y

requirements.requirement: KeyError, TypeError, ValidationError, IndexError, ValueError with traceback in Code/DataPipelines/ must be classified as PIPELINE without invoking the LLM.
requirements.label: Y

requirements.requirement: GPT-4.1-mini must only be invoked when rule-based precheck cannot classify the error.
requirements.label: Y

requirements.requirement: GPT-4.1-mini may only select repair_action values from a config-driven allowlist (restart_cluster, reconnect, scale_up, flush_connection_pool). It must not invent actions.
requirements.label: Y

requirements.requirement: All triage outputs (rule-based and LLM) must be logged for periodic review and tuning.
requirements.label: Y

features.name: Self-Repair Loop with Safety Limits
features.description: Infrastructure repair loop: GPT-4.1-mini picks repair action → execute → read logs to verify → retry up to M times. Evidence-must-change guardrail: if cluster state and error signature are unchanged after a repair attempt, skip remaining retries and escalate immediately.
features.evidence: Website/ops-manager-design.html (Infra Repair Loop, Repair Loop Guardrail). Audit Finding F4.

stories.title: Implement infra repair loop with evidence-must-change guardrail
stories.description: After each repair attempt, compare new evidence (cluster state + error signature) to previous attempt. If unchanged, skip remaining retries and escalate to Boss. Configurable M per environment.
stories.evidence: Website/ops-manager-design.html

requirements.requirement: Repair loop must retry up to M times (configurable per environment, stored in Brain config).
requirements.label: Y

requirements.requirement: After each repair attempt, the system must compare cluster_state and error_signature to the previous attempt. If both are unchanged, remaining retries must be skipped and Boss must be escalated immediately.
requirements.label: Y

requirements.requirement: Each repair attempt must read logs and check cluster status to verify the repair before deciding to retry or escalate.
requirements.label: Y

sprint_map.sprint_goal: PI Planning, Design, Implementation of Evaluate Care, Cost Reduction Pipeline, Smoke Test (DE only)

per_feature.mitigation: Enforce strict schema validation (existing requirements) and deterministic weighting; reject incomplete or non-conforming inputs at runtime.

per_measure.mitigation: ASSUMPTION: Measures will be provided upstream via existing provider data structures (ChatHealthy.Providers.json). Mitigation is to require all measures be explicitly passed and validated (no inference), and surface individual measure contributions in output to preserve transparency.

rejected_measure_candidates.name: Provider Years in Practice
rejected_measure_candidates.description: Years since enumeration or graduation from NPI data
rejected_measure_candidates.reason_dropped: Boss reduced to 3 provider measures. Experience is a proxy, not a direct quality signal.

rejected_measure_candidates.name: Provider Specialty Match Accuracy
rejected_measure_candidates.description: Score how well provider specialty matches user condition using NUCC taxonomy
rejected_measure_candidates.reason_dropped: Not a quality measure -- moved to provider triage (EVAL-P-TRIAGE).

rejected_measure_candidates.name: Provider Credential Completeness
rejected_measure_candidates.description: NPI credential completeness -- how many fields populated, license status
rejected_measure_candidates.reason_dropped: Overlaps with Board Certification measure. Subsumed by EVAL-P-MEASURE-BOARD.

rejected_measure_candidates.name: Clinical Trial Condition Relevance
rejected_measure_candidates.description: Does the trial condition match the user query

rejected_measure_candidates.name: Clinical Trial Proximity
rejected_measure_candidates.description: Distance from user to trial site
rejected_measure_candidates.reason_dropped: Logistics not quality -- moved to triage (EVAL-CT-TRIAGE-S3).

rejected_measure_candidates.name: FDA Approval Track Record
rejected_measure_candidates.description: Have this sponsors prior trials resulted in FDA approvals
rejected_measure_candidates.reason_dropped: Attribute of PI Credibility, not standalone. Folded into EVAL-CT-MEASURE-PI.

rejected_measure_candidates.name: Provider Patient Ratings Aggregation
rejected_measure_candidates.description: Aggregate patient ratings from external sources
rejected_measure_candidates.reason_dropped: No reliable public data source. External ratings are biased and gameable.
